title: Residential Technician
description:
Celebrate Life, the Southworth Way

The Company: Welcome to Southworth. We own and operate a growing portfolio of premier private communities, each offering inspired environments and locations. Our dedication to hospitality and endless activities for the entire family ensures our members experience a world at play like never before.

With a solid reputation for stability, integrity, and innovation, Southworth's clubs and communities provide exceptional locations where our members can truly live life at ease. Our dedicated team members play a crucial role in elevating the experience for our members, residents, guests, and fellow team members. We encourage all our team members to be and belong by providing a wide array of benefits, engagement programs, unique perks, discounts, and, of course, a lot of fun!

The Benefits: We are proud of our âfamily companyâ roots and understand everyone has a unique set of needs: we want to support you as best we can so you can live your best life with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive options for medical, physical, and mental health and wellness, life insurance, 401k matching, paid time off, and more.

Grow with us! The sky is the limit for talented, driven individuals. With our ever-expanding portfolio, we offer opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. We look forward to growing together.

Be YOU with us! At Southworth, we are working to redefine the country club. We seek talent from a diverse range of backgrounds, experiences, and cultures to ensure an innovative edge. Here, diversity is a driver of our success.

About The Abaco Club: The Abaco Club is a paradise for the soul. It is an unassuming haven crafted in the pursuit of connection, happiness and belonging. Here, members unwind in barefoot luxury in island-inspired homes, golfers take on the #1 golf course in The Bahamas, and generations come together on 2 miles of uninterrupted white sands on one of the most pristine beaches on Earth.

Working at The Abaco Club means being part of a vibrant community that values your knowledge and offers opportunities for professional growth and development. Here, you can turn your passion for hospitality into a rewarding career while enjoying the stunning scenery of this beautiful place. Become a part of our team and help us show what makes the Abaco Club truly extraordinary.

The Opportunity: The Residential Technician is responsible for performing preventive interior and exterior home maintenance, including monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, and annual services and inspections as assigned by the Homeowner Services Manager. This role ensures homes and Club facilities are maintained to the highest standards, working closely with Homeowners Representatives, Housekeeping, Front Desk, and Reservations. The technician will complete punch-list items, identify deficiencies, and follow through to resolution to preserve the Homeownersâ assets.

Duties And Functions

  • Coordinate with the Homeowner Services Manager and Assistant Manager on all home-related issues, ensuring timely follow-up with relevant departments.
  • Assist with the installation and setup of new homes as needed.
  • Inspect homes at least five days prior to member and guest arrivals to confirm they meet Club and Owner Standards; resolve maintenance issues promptly. Pre-arrival checks include: air filters, shower heads, bathroom hardware, kitchen appliances, HVAC functionality, light fixtures, bulbs, fans, internet/TV services, septic systems, door locks, propane levels, plumbing, grills, and any reported issues.
  • Conduct monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance services per the Management program.
  • Record all services and inspections using the designated app, including work performed, materials used, and time allocated.
  • Inspect and maintain all aspects of the homeâs interior and exterior, including pools and pool equipment.
  • Assist with golf cart and vehicle maintenance/cleaning as assigned.
  • Support maintenance of Club outlets and facilities as directed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Qualification Standards

  • Minimum of 2 yearsâ experience in a similar or related role
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and flexible work schedule
  • Physically able to stand, bend, and lift up to 30 lbs for extended periods
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Professional demeanor with integrity and a positive attitude
  • Strong teamwork skills with the ability to interact respectfully with residents, guests, and colleagues
  • Knowledge of standard maintenance policies and procedures
  • Availability to work weekends and holidays as required

The Residential Technician is a vital part of ensuring that homes and Club facilities meet the highest standards for members and guests. This position contributes directly to the quality of the homeowner experience by preserving property integrity and delivering prompt, professional service.

Apply today to start your new career, the Southworth Way
